task_completion.description: Set Stellarium location to ALMA Observatory coordinates (-23.019, -67.753) and 5058m altitude.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Location window in Stellarium showing Latitude -23.019, Longitude -67.753, and Altitude 5058m, or the status bar reflecting ALMA/Chajnantor.

task_completion.description: Set the simulation time to April 10, 2017, at 08:00 UTC.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Date/Time window or the bottom status bar showing 2017-04-10 and 08:00:00.

task_completion.description: Disable atmosphere and landscape, and enable the azimuthal coordinate grid.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The main view showing a black sky (no atmosphere), no ground/landscape, and visible azimuthal grid lines (vertical/horizontal lines centered on the zenith).

task_completion.description: Locate and center the view on Sagittarius A* (or Gamma Sagittarii).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The target 'Sagittarius A*' or 'Gamma Sagittarii' is selected with a crosshair/pointer and centered in the screen; the info text in the top left confirms the target name.

task_completion.description: Save a screenshot of the centered target to the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager window or terminal output showing a new image file created in ~/Pictures/stellarium/.

task_completion.description: Create a text report at ~/Desktop/eht_alma_schedule.txt with required details.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or 'cat' command output showing a file containing 'ALMA', 'April 10, 2017', the target name, and horizon status.

integrity.description: The agent used the Stellarium GUI to configure settings rather than just editing config files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the Stellarium window active with open dialog boxes (Location, Date/Time, Search).

integrity.description: The visual state of the sky matches the specific date and location requested.
integrity.visual_evidence: The star field and grid orientation in the screenshot correspond to the specified coordinates and time, not a default view.

integrity.description: The report and screenshot files were actually created during the session.
integrity.visual_evidence: Timestamps or file explorer views showing the existence of the files in the specified paths.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The ALMA Observatory is located at Lat: -23.019, Lon: -67.753, Alt: 5058m. On April 10, 2017, at 08:00 UTC, Sagittarius A* is visible from this location (Altitude ~+50°). The agent must disable atmosphere (shortcut 'A') and landscape (shortcut 'G') and enable the azimuthal grid (shortcut 'Z'). The report must be at ~/Desktop/eht_alma_schedule.txt and the screenshot at ~/Pictures/stellarium/.
